onboarding.modelWillLoad: Loads only when you open AI chat
onboarding.unknownError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
onboarding.welcomeLede: A safety companion for long trips — check-ins, sharing, and money, all on your phone. Nothing on our servers, ever.
onboarding.safetyLede: Location, trusted three, and an offline fallback — set up in one pass.
onboarding.locationBody: Powers check-in timers, geofences, and emergency broadcasts. Adapts to save battery when you're still.
onboarding.smsMissCheckIn: SMS if you miss a check-in
onboarding.offlineBody: Lost signal mid-trek? We fall back to SMS — alerts still reach your three with your last GPS fix.
onboarding.locationAlwaysSub: Tap to allow location for SOS and sharing
onboarding.contactsPermissionSub: Tap to choose your trusted three from contacts
onboarding.smsPermissionSub: Tap to verify SMS is available for offline alerts
onboarding.permissionNote: You can change these later in device Settings. Only required permissions are requested now.
onboarding.locationRequiredBody: NomadSafe needs location access for SOS alerts, live sharing, and check-ins. Please enable it in Settings.
onboarding.contactsRequiredBody: NomadSafe needs contacts access to let you pick your trusted three. Please enable it in Settings.
onboarding.biometricPrompt: Confirm your identity to secure NomadSafe
onboarding.biometricSetUpSub: Set up Face ID, Touch ID, or fingerprint in device Settings first
onboarding.smsReceipt: ₹1,240 spent on card ••4182 at Café Lisboa
onboarding.ledgerLede: Grant access to your transaction emails and bank SMS — we read receipts and spend alerts, then categorise and split them automatically. Parsing happens on-device; messages never leave your phone.
onboarding.readsReceipts: Reads receipts & bank statements — nothing else
onboarding.groupSplitSub: Auto-split meals, stays, rides with co-travellers
onboarding.categoryBudgetsSub: Food, transit, stays — roll over automatically
onboarding.zeroTelemetrySub: No servers, no tokens shipped off device
onboarding.aiLede: Forecast spend, split bills, and answer trip questions locally. The model runs offline and never sees your cloud account.
onboarding.cloudAiSub: Prompts, receipts, and locations leave the device for processing.
onboarding.onDeviceSub: Receipts, location, and trip context stay inside your phone.
onboarding.deviceSupported: This device can run local AI
onboarding.deviceLimited: This device may struggle with local AI
onboarding.deviceUnsupported: Local AI is not available on this device
onboarding.limitedAiSub: Some AI features will use cloud mode. You can still use most trip tools.
onboarding.unsupportedAiSub: AI answers will use cloud mode. Local model download is disabled.
onboarding.downloadBackgroundHint: Keeps downloading in the background — you can continue setup.
onboarding.notifyWhenReadySub: Get a notification when the model finishes downloading.
onboarding.downloadModelBody: {{model}} needs {{size}} of storage and works best with {{ram}} GB RAM. Download over Wi‑Fi when possible.
onboarding.modelWillLoad: Loads only when you open AI chat · nothing runs in background
onboarding.secureLede: Trip data, receipts and contacts encrypted on-device with {{biometricName}} + {{keyStoreName}} keys. No cloud, no leaks, no recovery calls — just you.
onboarding.backupPinLede: If {{biometricName}} or your fingerprint doesn't work, a 6-digit PIN unlocks the vault. It's stored only on this device.
onboarding.readyLede: Everything's encrypted, offline-ready, and protected by {{protectedBy}}. Have a safe one.

safetyFeatures: Safety status: idle / active / emergency states
Check-in countdown timer with extend & custom durations
Big SOS trigger that broadcasts to the trusted three
sharingFeatures: Live broadcasting toggle with current location label
Update strategy: normal / low-power / max accuracy
End-to-end encrypted share links with expiry
expensesFeatures: Spend chart over the last 14 days
Auto-logged entries parsed from email + SMS (on-device)
Scan receipt to add an expense
aiFeatures: Daily spend trend (last 7 days) + category breakdown
Avg/day, streaks, by-day and top-merchant stats
Suggested prompts: overspend, forecast, biggest category
Chat answers computed locally — 0 bytes leave the device
tripsFeatures: Current trip card with day X/Y progress
Create a trip: destination, dates, solo or group
Invite companions to a group trip
